unit: The student can welcome a guest, introduce someone, make basic small talk, and politely offer a drink.
objective: Accept or decline an offer politely.

title: Warm-up
subtitle: Let's talk about drinks.
question: When someone offers you a drink, do you usually choose coffee or tea?
starters: Actually, I don't drink coffee or tea. I prefer...

title: Useful Language (Part 1)
teacher_instructions: Read each word aloud and ask the student to repeat after you.
Read the definition and the example sentence.
Ask the check question to confirm understanding.
Ask the student to make their own sentence using one of the words.

words.definition: Used to accept an offer or agree to something.
words.example: Yes, I would like some tea.
words.check: If your friend offers you some water and you want it, do you say 'yes' or 'no'?

words.definition: Used to be polite when making a request or accepting an offer.
words.example: Yes, please. I would love some.
words.check: Which is more polite: 'Water!' or 'Water, please'?

title: Useful Language (Part 2)
teacher_instructions: Read each word aloud and ask the student to repeat.
Read the definition and example sentence.
Ask the check question to confirm understanding.
Ask the student to make their own sentence using one of the words.

words.definition: A word used to say that you do not want something.
words.example: No, I don't want any coffee.
words.check: If you aren't thirsty and someone offers you water, do you say yes or no?

words.definition: A polite phrase used when someone helps you or offers you something.
words.check: Do you say thank you to be polite or to be angry?

title: Conversation Builder
goal: Accept or decline an offer politely.

linkers.use: To say yes to a drink.

model:
Tutor: Would you like some coffee?
Student: Yes, please.

Tutor: How about some tea?
Student: No, thank you. Just water, please.

your_turn.teacher: Offer the student coffee or tea. Practice three times so they can use all the phrases.
your_turn.student: Listen to your tutor. Reply with 'Yes, please,' 'No, thank you,' or 'Just water, please.'

title: Let's practice
teacher_question: Imagine you're visiting my office and I offer you a drink. I'll ask, 'Would you like some coffee?' or 'Would you like some tea?' Use the frames below to answer.

title: Real-world scenario
role_a: Tutor: You are the host. Offer the guest coffee and tea.
role_b: Student: You are the guest. Listen to the host and respond.
problem: The host will offer you coffee and tea. You want one of the drinks, but not the other.
mission: Listen to the host offer you coffee.
Listen to the host offer you tea.
Say 'Yes, please' to one drink and 'No, thank you' to the other.
start: Welcome! Come on in. Would you like some coffee?

title: Wrap-up
recap: Vocabulary: yes, please, no, thank you
Chunks: Yes, please. / No, thank you. / Just water, please.
Skill: I can politely accept or decline a drink.
final_task: Use one of today's chunks to respond to this offer: 'Would you like some coffee?'
challenge: Try using these polite responses the next time someone offers you a drink.
